data.name: ALPINE
data.detailed_description:
ALPINE — is a multiplayer game about climbing to the very top of a mountain. Any mistake by a player or the team can lead to death. You play as brave mountaineers whose goal is to conquer the mountain peak. Set out alone or with friends on an exciting and demanding journey, face hardships and overcome them together, hand in hand with your comrades. Help each other, gather resources, and create useful items that will ultimately help you conquer this dangerous and impregnable mountain.

PLAY SOLO OR TOGETHER

Climbing the mountain alone is an incredibly brave step bordering on the impossible. But what if you bring equally daring friends or find like-minded people ready to storm this unassailable summit together?

NATURE IS STRONGER THAN HUMANS

Mountaineering is always a test of human strength against the power of nature. Here you will face harsh weather conditions, deadly cliffs, and unpredictable avalanches. Every step can be your last if you are not careful and attentive. Nature does not forgive mistakes, but it is in this confrontation that the true spirit of mountaineering lies. Do not trifle with nature; listen to what the great nature is telling you. Play not against it, but with it.

CRAFTING AND SURVIVAL ELEMENTS

As you progress, you will gather resources and craft new items and tools. Build bridges, climb ropes, use ziplines, and construct suspended platforms to rest and regain strength.

Set up camps, light fires, pitch tents—protect your life and the lives of your teammates.

A CONSTANTLY GENERATED WORLD.

Each attempt is a new experience and a new mountain. Embark on a unique journey unlike the previous ones. Every time awaits a new challenge that can be overcome solo or with friends.

GAME FEATURES:

  • Play solo or with friends, up to 6 players.

  • Procedural generation of the mountain. A new mountain every time.

  • Build camps and craft new items, from axes to insulated clothing.

  • Communicate via in-game chat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD R9 270X
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
